item.description:
RT The Vigilant Fox 🦊
Re Next came the moment no one expected—but everyone would be talking about.

Elon Musk stepped in and everything went quiet.

“I think this could be the greatest administration since the founding of the country.”

It wasn’t a soundbite. It was a moment.

At the 100-day milestone, Musk addressed the full cabinet. He didn’t waste words. He spoke with intent.

“The American people voted for secure borders, safe cities, and sensible spending,” he said.

“And that’s what they’ve gotten.”

He praised the pace, the action, and the execution.

“A tremendous amount has been accomplished in the first 100 days. As everyone has said, it's more than has been accomplished in ANY administration before. Ever. Period.”

And then he looked ahead.

“So this portends well for what happens for the rest of the administration.”

This will be the quote that should dominate headlines:

“I think this could be the greatest administration since the founding of the country.”

item.title: RT The Vigilant Fox 🦊: EYE-WATERING MOMENT: Trump’s cabinet erupts in applause for Elon Musk—thanking him for the personal sacrifices he’s made ...
item.description:
RT The Vigilant Fox 🦊
EYE-WATERING MOMENT: Trump’s cabinet erupts in applause for Elon Musk—thanking him for the personal sacrifices he’s made to help save the country.

It wasn’t scripted. It wasn’t expected. But it was real—and it said everything that needed to be said.

@elonmusk sat quietly at the table.

For months, he’s taken hit after hit: media smears, political attacks, even firebombings at Tesla—all for standing up for the American people and helping the Trump administration deliver on its promises.

And in this moment, he finally heard what millions have been wanting to say.

President Trump looked him in the eye.

“You have been treated unfairly,” he said.

“But the vast majority of people in this country really respect and appreciate you.”

Heads around the room nodded.

“You’ve really been a tremendous help,” Trump added.

“You opened up a lot of eyes as to what could be done.”

Then came the applause. The room ignited.

It wasn’t for a billionaire.

It was for an American fighter—someone who’s risked everything not to stay safe, but stand up for his country.

Musk sat there humbled by it all. He then said a few words:

“It’s also an honor to work with your incredible cabinet,” he said.

“Thank you everyone. It’s great to work with you.”

🚨🇮🇩 INDONESIAN ISLANDS FINALLY CONNECTED: STARLINK MINI HITS ARCHIPELAGO

SpaceX just unleashed its backpack-sized internet revolution across Indonesia's 17,000+ islands - a game-changer for a nation where connectivity has always meant compromise.

The impossibly tiny Starlink Mini (just 2.56 pounds!) has landed at $299, bringing space internet to remote locations that fiber and cell towers will never reach.

For Indonesia's digital nomads in Bali, remote workers in Sumatra, fishermen at sea, and villagers in Papua, this pocket-sized dish delivers up to 250Mbps downloads while sipping just 15-20W of power - easily handled by a portable battery bank or small solar setup.

No more climbing hills for a signal or watching upload bars crawl for hours.

The Mini works in backpacks, on boat decks, and vehicle rooftops - perfect for a country where your next destination might be hours from the nearest cell tower.

The archipelago's geography has always made consistent connectivity a national challenge.

Now Elon's tiny dish might finally bridge Indonesia's digital divide - one island at a time.

Let me explain this to everyone so people stop pushing this lie. Obama changed the classification of deportations to include “turnaways”.

Turnaways are basically just arresting an illegal at the border when they try to enter and “deporting” them back to Mexico. It’s not an actual deportation.

This allowed the Democrats to claim they were deporting people without actually deporting people from the interior.

It also allowed them to open the floodgates and still have high “deportation” numbers. The more people you invite to come in, the more people you can “turnaway” at the border and the better your fake deportation number looks.

What Trump did is make it very clear to illegals that they would not get in. Thus turnaway “deportations” have fallen to near zero. Instead they are focusing on interior deportations which are the only deportations that matter.

So the next time you say that Obama deported millions or Trump is deporting less than Biden, know that you are spreading Democrat propaganda bullshit.

item.description:
RT Mario Nawfal
DAVID SACKS: ELON ISN’T LEAVING DOGE - HE’S SHIFTING TO STRATEGIC MANAGEMENT

“I saw this before when I was part of the Twitter transition - for the first 3 months or so, he was basically full-time at Twitter HQ, learning the business down to the database level.

Once he felt he had a mental model and he had the people in place that he trusted, he can move to more of a maintenance mode.

He has these intense bursts where he focuses on something, gets the right people and structure in place, feels like he understands it, and then he can delegate more.

So my sense is that DOGE is going to continue, it's just that Elon is shifting to a mode where he can manage it 1 day a week or 2 days a week, as opposed to being there 5 days a week.”

Source: @stevenmarkryan, @DavidSacks

item.title: RT Mike P: The way Dems have handled Elon’s presence and work at DOGE has probably sealed my fate as a 3rd party or GOP voter indefinitely. I can’t ...
item.description:
RT Mike P
The way Dems have handled Elon’s presence and work at DOGE has probably sealed my fate as a 3rd party or GOP voter indefinitely. I can’t imagine voting for a democrat after how I’ve seen them behave this year.

My general views align more closely to views of oldschool moderate democrats, but after watching Dems purposely try to destroy the biggest and most impactful clean energy company in America, I just have no trust that anything they say they believe in is actually real. If it was, the outcomes would override anything else. But they didn’t with Tesla. Their desire to hate one guy was more important to them than reducing GHG emissions and accelerating the USA towards a sustainable future. It showed me how weak and childish democratic leadership has become.

They spent the early 2000s telling me the planet was on the verge of death, and now in 2025 I watch them sell their 0 emissions cars for gas guzzlers while trying to convince me it is righteous. Pure insanity.

Will take a total purging of these sorts of people from DNC before I’d be able to trust them again.
